speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Could you please describe the skin lesions you've noticed, including when they first appeared and whether they are painful or itchy?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-year-old female. The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Skin biopsy
The painless, nonpruritic nature and daycare exposure suggest Molluscum contagiosum, but I need to rule out other viral exanthems.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Lobules of molluscum bodies (Henderson-Paterson bodies) in the epidermis

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of Henderson-Paterson bodies confirms the diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Molluscum contagiosum
